mapper.sql: r.id, r.coach_id AS coachId, r.product_id AS productId, r.standard_lesson_count AS standardLessonCount, r.commission_rate AS commissionRate, r.below_standard_lesson_fee AS belowStandardLessonFee, r.created_at AS createdAt, r.updated_at AS updatedAt, p.product_name AS productName, p.sale_price AS salePrice, p.lesson_count AS productLessonCount, p.listing_status AS listingStatus
mapper.select: SELECT FROM pt_coach_monthly_commission_rule r INNER JOIN pt_product p ON p.id = r.product_id WHERE r.coach_id = #{coachId} ORDER BY r.id ASC
SELECT FROM pt_coach_monthly_commission_rule r INNER JOIN pt_product p ON p.id = r.product_id WHERE r.coach_id = #{coachId} AND r.product_id = #{productId} LIMIT 1

SELECT p.id AS productId, p.product_name AS productName, p.sale_price AS salePrice, p.lesson_count AS productLessonCount, p.listing_status AS listingStatus FROM pt_product p WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND p.product_type_id = 3 ORDER BY p.listing_status DESC, p.sort_no DESC, p.id DESC
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM pt_product WHERE id = #{productId} AND deleted = 0 AND product_type_id = 3
